notes: "install" requires `kind == .missingDependency && missingDependency != nil` -- a missing-dependency problem whose target is a non-installable loader/minecraft/java name (see `StartupCrashAnalyzer`'s `nonInstallable` set, `StartupCrashAnalyzer.swift:235-236`) carries `missingDependency == nil` and so never offers "install", even though its kind is `.missingDependency` -- covered by the next case.
